entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.code_description: In immediate packings of a net content not exceeding two litres
entries.comment:
Fresh milk, not concentrated or sweetened, intended for food consumption, packaged for retail sale, subjected to pasteurization or other treatments required by health laws.
The reduced rate of 4% applies only if fresh milk intended for food consumption packaged for retail sale subjected to pasteurization and other treatments provided for by health laws. 
The reduced rate of 4% applies also to the following items: 0401 40 10 90, 0401 50 11 90, 0401 50 31 90, 0401 50 91 90.
